questions: Are you experiencing involuntary shaking, jerking, or flapping movements of your hands?
Are the movements present when your hands are at rest?
Do the movements worsen when you hold your arms out or use your hands?
Do both hands move in the same way?
Have you noticed weakness or clumsiness on one side of your body?
Have you had numbness or loss of sensation?
Have you had difficulty speaking, understanding speech, seeing, or walking?
Have you had a severe or unusual headache?
Have you lost awareness or had episodes of staring or unresponsiveness?
Have you recently had confusion, unusual sleepiness, or a change in your behavior?
Have you had fever, vomiting, or significant dehydration recently?
Do you have known liver disease?
Do you have known kidney disease?
Do you have diabetes or thyroid disease?
Have you started, stopped, or changed any medications recently?
Do you use alcohol or recreational drugs?
Have you had similar episodes before?

dx_raw:
DIAGNOSIS: Chronic length-dependent axonal sensorimotor polyneuropathy, most consistent with hereditary axonal Charcot–Marie–Tooth neuropathy (CMT2), with associated neuropathic postural tremor

ALTERNATIVE 1: Chronic idiopathic axonal sensorimotor polyneuropathy with neuropathic tremor

ALTERNATIVE 2: Functional postural tremor superimposed on an axonal polyneuropathy

ALTERNATIVE 3: Chronic immune-mediated inflammatory polyneuropathy with predominantly axonal features and neuropathic tremor
